name: Bun sung
summary: Crab riêu noodles with sliced sung fruit and seasoned pork crackling, also called bún tóp mỡ. Tuổi Trẻ describes a lightly sweet broth smelling of field crab, soft roe, crisp rich crackling, and a mild tannin from the sung.
origin: Nam Định. Tuổi Trẻ, 24 November 2021, and Dân Việt, 5 September 2025.
taste: Tuổi Trẻ calls the broth lightly sweet, smelling of đồng crab, with soft crab roe, crisp rich crackling, and a mild tannin from the sung. You mix the fruit with chili vinegar, sugar, and seasoning powder.
howToEat: Tuổi Trẻ says it fills students and workers in the early morning or after work, and that winter is when the bowl is at its best. One stall that day ran from 06:00 to 20:00.
The same article prints 10,000 đồng for a full bowl and a resident’s hơn 10,000 đồng, with add-ons of chả cá, fried fish, mọc, or chả lá lốt at 15,000–20,000 đồng. Those are November 2021 prices.
where: Chợ Diên Hồng on the 2021 account, and chợ Ngõ Ngang on the 5 September 2025 list.
seoTitle: Bun sung — crab noodles, sung, and crackling
seoDescription: Crab riêu with sung fruit and pork crackling at chợ Diên Hồng or chợ Ngõ Ngang. Tuổi Trẻ printed 10,000 đồng a bowl in 2021.
